title: Azure Key Vault Secrets Management
description: Securely store and manage secrets, keys, and certificates with Azure Key Vault.

data.text: Your application needs database connection strings, API keys for third-party services, and SSL certificates. Currently stored in appsettings.json. How do you secure them without code changes?

Move all secrets to **Azure Key Vault**. Use **Managed Identity** for authentication. Enable **soft-delete** and **purge protection**. Use **Key Vault references** in App Service/Functions configuration.

data.title: Azure CLI - Key Vault Setup
data.code:
# Create Key Vault
az keyvault create \
  --name 'kv-myapp-prod' \
  --resource-group 'rg-security' \
  --enable-soft-delete true \
  --enable-purge-protection true \
  --location 'eastus'

# Add secret
az keyvault secret set --vault-name 'kv-myapp-prod' --name 'DbConnectionString' --value 'Server=...'

# App Service config reference
@Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://kv-myapp-prod.vault.azure.net/secrets/DbConnectionString/)

data.text: **Key Vault** provides HSM-backed encryption, access control via RBAC, and audit logging. Secrets never appear in plaintext in your code or configuration files.
